sections.heading: ESG built into how we invest
ledes: TELEO Capital believes that in order to provide significant risk-adjusted returns to our investors, we need to be committed to the highest standards of business practices and ethical standards. We believe that introducing environmental, social, and corporate governance ("ESG") considerations to our investment process can be essential to creating value for our investors and developing more sustainable long-term success at our portfolio companies.

A wide range of ESG issues are addressed as part of the investment decision-making process, and these issues are managed post-investment. By incorporating ESG considerations into investment analysis and ownership practices, TELEO Capital can create additional value for all stakeholders and reduce the financial and reputational risks to which they are exposed.

We may share information with service providers who support our operations, with professional advisors, and where required by law or to protect our legal rights. We do not share your information with third parties for their own marketing purposes.

We maintain reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards designed to protect the information we collect. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, however, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
Your Choices & Rights
Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal information. To make a request, contact us using the details below.

The Site may link to third-party websites, including our investor portal. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those sites, and we encourage you to review their policies.
